utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs doing, and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s now on Sunday at the community center. I can help out—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—what jobs are still left for me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s happening Sunday at the community center now. If you can send me the updated list, I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll send over the updated list right away and keep it lined up with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — once I get the list, I’ll fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out on errands, so I’ll swing by a couple places and check what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira—could you check what we still need and where the supplies should go? Since it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, I’m trying to keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll check what’s still needed and confirm where the supplies should go at the community center. I’ll let you know what I find on my errands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll bring anything useful by the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — Saturday morning at the community center sounds good. I’ll let you know if I need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be there Saturday morning with anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks for the update — I’ll tell everyone the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks Vik — that should keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply list going, and I’ll let you know what we still need before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo — I’d love that. Just let me know what’s still needed, and I can help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll check the tools and spare parts, then send you the list of what we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — it’s at the community center on Maple Street this Saturday from 10 to 2. I’ll spread the word and see if they still need hands-on repair help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks Quinn. Send me the list whenever you have it, and I’ll help keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll round up the details and send you the list soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. Thanks for helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Sunday at the community center works—I’ll plan for that and focus on the broken fence and porch lights.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Eli—those are the two big ones. I’ll keep track of the location change and let everyone know it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet—Noah and Cleo are still checking tools and spare parts. The drive is Sunday at the community center on Maple Street, so I’ll send more once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—just to confirm, once Noah and Cleo finish checking tools and spare parts, will you send the updated list?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can check what else is still needed and send you a quick note. I’m a bit tied up, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be great, Bo—just send me a quick note when you can. Sunday at the community center is set now, so any update on tools or volunteers will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely — I’ll send a quick note with any tools or volunteers I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—just tell me what tools you’re still missing for the repair drive, and I can bring by a few.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus! It’s at the community center on Sunday now, and I’ll pass along what’s still needed once I hear the latest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Tess—just send me the updated list when you have it, and I’ll see what I can bring by Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — Saturday morning at the community center works for the neighborhood repair drive for the broken fence and porch lights. I appreciate you bringing whatever tools and small appliances you can find.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds great—what’s still needed most right now? If there’s one thing folks should bring, I’d love to pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mostly tools, especially screwdrivers, hammers, and a drill if anyone has one. Small spare parts or extension cords would help too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mina—that’d be a huge help. Let me know what you find, and I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I'll bring any tools or spare parts I can find to the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mina—I really appreciate it. See you at the community center Saturday morning, and I’ll keep checking for anything else we need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can drop by Saturday morning with anything I find. If I hear of anyone needing help, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo — that’s really helpful. Just a heads-up, the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll bring anything useful I find and let folks know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks for checking in — the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center on Maple Street. I’ll send the full details now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center on Maple Street works. I’ll bring some tools and small appliances if I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Hana — I’ve got you down for Sunday at the community center on Maple Street. Thanks for bringing tools and small appliances!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still trying to sort out the logistics—what tools do we already have, and what are we still missing for Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help inventory what we’ve got and what’s missing for Sunday. Tell me what’s already collected, and I’ll see what else I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday at the community center works for me. Send me the list when you can, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli. I’ll send the list and keep the plan set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, thank you. I’ll keep Sunday clear and wait for your list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please send me the full list of repairs and supplies. The drive is now Sunday at the community center, so I’ll use that to coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—can you send me the full list, and I’ll confirm what’s still needed for Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still checking what needs fixing for the repair drive. I’ll let you know if I end up needing that wrench or screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good—just let me know what you need and I can help out too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. I’ll check and let you know what I end up needing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can bring those easy fixes by, and if you tell me what’s still short, I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — I’m checking the supplies now and I’ll let you know what we’re still missing before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the short list when you have it, and I’ll see what I can drop off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara — just a quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. What can I help you with first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll head to the community center on Sunday and help with whatever needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Mara—thank you. I’ll keep things organized and let you know if anything else changes before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, quick update — the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch. I’ll pass along anything else I hear!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center now. If you hear what kind of help is still needed, send it my way and I’ll pass it on too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear what still needs doing. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can check the list and see what’s still missing for the repair drive. Then we can sort through it together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help a lot—what’s still missing most right now?
